note: Each workflow stays pending until the feature slice that implements it adds its scenario. scripts/check_prototype_isolation.js fails if one is removed, renumbered or marked done without a scenario.

workflows.title: Build a recipe
workflows.steps: Build a recipe from a genre, edit a part, set an environment and copy all four formats. Reload: the workspace is restored. Undo and Redo work within the session; after a reload the history starts at the restored snapshot. The signature strip shows the workspace centroid and the four nearest traditions once the workspace has two or more cards.

workflows.title: Saved workspaces
workflows.steps: Save, rename, fork and delete a saved workspace, with a truthful autosave status. Delete keeps its confirmation and its truthful failure message.

workflows.title: Write a song
workflows.steps: On Lyrics: brief, draft and Review; a refusal with its named next step; recovery after a failed or interrupted run.

workflows.title: Library
workflows.steps: Find a work, read it, select a passage, run an analysis, cancel and resume it, export, hand off to Lyrics, use Back and Forward.

workflows.title: Map
workflows.steps: Search, filter, pan and zoom by pointer, touch and keyboard, open a tradition, return.

workflows.title: Errors and offline
workflows.steps: Catalog fetch failure, connector unavailable and file://, each with an honest message.
